title: fix(tasks): task list fails when metadata overlaps completion
body:
## What Problem This Solves

A task-list request can fail when a successful metadata write overlaps task completion.

## User Impact

Return the current completed task after accepted metadata settles. Superseded notifications remain suppressed, including when a row changes and later returns to the same value. No schema, migration, or configuration changes.

## Why This Change Was Made

Apply the strict expected-row guard only to recovered publications. Carry the existing write witness into publication invalidation before receipt claim and through later writes, preserving admission, rollback, and observer ownership.

## Evidence

Before the callback declaration amendment, focused qualification passed 101 cases: 19 read, 36 publication, 39 event, and 7 lineage tests, with no skipped cases, unhandled errors, or suite errors. This includes the registered Gateway tasks.list regression, three existing stale-notification cases, and three SQLite recovery controls. The read regression failed on the original code; the queued-readback regression failed on the preceding candidate and passes with this fix. The queued-readback test uses the production publication owner with the existing in-memory store; event tests supply SQLite coverage.

The focused run used 137f4ba73e7ccce65ff178ba8d694b91c164a754. All five patch preimages match observed main 1a51b551ec7dc9f9e8ef949687e7d0392c2f2eb1; its landed retry-budget change is included in the reviewed supporting context. The original five-file change passed formatting and patch checks, and independent automatic review completed both evidence batches without P0-P2 findings. These results predate the callback declaration amendment.

CI on 8e206401 flagged the extracted recovery callback under the unbound-method rule. The amendment changes its factory method declaration to an arrow property while preserving its closure behavior. Amendment formatting and patch checks passed. Local type-aware lint was not run because no suitable idle source and dependency checkout was available within the allocated memory limit. The narrow amendment review completed without P0-P2 findings. Fresh amended-head CI, including type-aware lint, must pass before landing.

The broader 32-agent/1,000-session live campaign remains outstanding. This change makes no throughput, latency, or startup-speed claim.
